overview: The Croods is a 2013 American animated adventure comedy film produced by DreamWorks Animation. The film was written and directed by Chris Sanders and Kirk DeMicco, both of whom co-wrote the story with John Cleese. The film stars the voices of Nicolas Cage, Emma Stone, Ryan Reynolds, Catherine Keener, Clark Duke, and Cloris Leachman. It is set in a fictional prehistoric Pliocene era known as "The Croodaceous" where Grug (Cage), patriarch of the Croods, is threatened by the arrival of a genius named Guy (Reynolds), who comes up with revolutionary new inventions as they trek through a dangerous land in search of a new home.
